headline: Your money, your terms — a fixed rate you can actually see
subheading: Open a term account in minutes and watch your savings grow on a schedule you set.
body_paragraphs: You work hard for your money. So why let it sit in an account that pays you next to nothing? A term account locks in your rate for the length of time you choose, so you always know what you're getting.
You pick the term. You pick the amount. You get a clear rate from day one — no tiers, no small print surprises, no branch appointment required.
You can open your account online in minutes, track it in the app, and add to it whenever it suits you. Your money stays yours, and your rate stays put.
Join thousands of savers who've already made the switch. See your rate before you commit, and get started today.
